entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! My VeloBand is a complete piece of junk. I paid a premium for this thing and it's already broken! This is unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing an issue. I can definitely help you with that. Can I start with your name and the order number for the band?
The name's Alex Chen, order number is... uh... VF55-9012. Look, the heart rate monitor is giving crazy readings, and now the whole device won't sync with the app. It's just not working at all.

Thank you for that, Alex. I've located your account. I understand your frustration. To make sure I find the right solution, is it a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue with the features?

Are you listening to me?! I just told you it's broken! It is a defective piece of plastic! It won't sync, the battery drains in a few hours... I don't want troubleshooting, I want my money back. I've had it less than a month! Get me your manager right now, or I swear I will post a video of this thing getting run over by my car on every social media site.

I understand your anger, Alex, and I assure you there's no need for a manager. I can handle this directly for you. I see here that you are one of our VIP customers, and we certainly don't want you to have this experience. Let me just review the policy for your purchase date.
Okay, one moment... Right. I see you received the item on December 15th, which was 28 days ago. Let me check.
Thank you for your patience. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return period. I can absolutely process a full return for this defective unit immediately. No questions asked.
Wait, really? A full refund? You're not going to try to send me to some other department?

That's correct. A full refund. Given the trouble you've had and as a thank you for your loyalty as a VIP customer, I'm also going to add a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. I'm emailing you the pre-paid return shipping label as we speak.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's... actually what I wanted. Thank you. I appreciate you just handling it.
Of course. It's my pleasure to resolve this for you. You should see that email in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
No, that's it. I'll look for the email. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
